product_overview: Ziratstan.kz is a lightweight, mobile-first web platform for discovering, digitizing and preserving memorial profiles and cemetery data across Kazakhstan, with map-based discovery, crowdsourced biography updates (UGC), QR generation and cemetery-care service ordering.
core_goals: Provide fast, offline-capable map discovery of cemeteries and VIP memorial profiles using Leaflet and clustering.
Enable crowdsourced enrichment of biographies and cemetery metadata with a moderation workflow (UGC).
Allow generation and distribution of QR codes linking physical memorials to rich profile pages.
Support service ordering (cemetery care) and capture leads for monetization.
Keep the frontend static, performant and mobile-first while persisting data to Supabase with localStorage fallback.

features.name: Map Navigation
features.description: Interactive cemetery map to discover VIP profiles and local gravesites, filter by historical era, search by name, and open profile pages from map markers or clusters.
user_flows: Navigate to /map.html -> Map loads with markers and clusters visible -> Use the search bar to enter a person name -> See matching marker(s) highlighted on map -> Click the highlighted marker -> See marker popup with "Ашырту" button -> Click "Ашырту" -> Navigate to /profile.html?id=mirzhakyp_24 -> See profile page load

Navigate to /map.html -> Map loads -> Click era filter button (e.g. alash) -> Map updates to show only profiles for selected era -> Click a cluster to zoom in -> Click an individual marker -> See popup with profile summary -> Click "Ашырту" -> Navigate to /profile.html?id=...

Navigate to /map.html -> Map loads -> Use the search bar to enter a non-existent name -> See "No results" message in the search UI -> Click "Create profile" (UGC) in the popup or sidebar -> Open new profile UGC modal/form for user submission

features.name: View Profile
features.description: Display a memorial profile with biography, images, family tree (шежіре), and QR-code actions; provide entry points to submit biography additions (UGC) and to generate/view QR codes.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile.html?id=mirzhakyp_24 -> Profile page loads with hero photo, basic details and short bio visible -> Click to read biography (expand) -> Full biography text displays -> Click "View family tree" -> Family tree schema displays
Navigate to /profile.html?id=mirzhakyp_24 -> Profile page loads -> Click "View QR" or "Generate QR" -> Navigate to /qr.html?slug=ZRT-1234 -> See QR code with download and copy link options
Navigate to /profile.html?id=mirzhakyp_24 -> Profile page loads -> Click "Өмірбаянды толықтыру" -> UGC biography modal opens

Navigate to /profile.html?id=mirzhakyp_24 -> Profile page loads -> Click "Generate QR" -> API call to /rest/v1/qr_codes fails (network or server) -> See error toast "QR generation failed" -> Click "Retry" -> Click "Generate QR" again -> On success navigate to /qr.html?slug=ZRT-1234

features.name: Add Bio Suggestion (UGC)
features.description: Allow visitors or relatives to submit biography additions for moderation; submissions are POSTed to Supabase and fall back to localStorage if offline.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile.html?id=mirzhakyp_24 -> Profile page loads -> Click "Өмірбаянды толықтыру" -> UGC modal opens with author and biography fields -> Fill author name field -> Fill biography text field -> Click "Жіберу" -> POST to /rest/v1/ugc_bio_submissions -> See success message "Submitted for moderation"

Navigate to /profile.html?id=mirzhakyp_24 -> Profile page loads -> Click "Өмірбаянды толықтыру" -> UGC modal opens -> Leave biography text empty -> Click "Жіберу" -> See validation error "Biography required" -> Fill biography text -> Click "Жіберу" -> See success message

Navigate to /profile.html?id=mirzhakyp_24 -> Profile page loads -> Click "Өмірбаянды толықтыру" -> UGC modal opens -> Fill author name and biography -> Click "Жіберу" while offline or when API returns network error -> See error message "Network error, submission saved locally" -> Submission persisted to localStorage for later sync

features.name: Order Care Service
features.description: Collect customer orders for cemetery care (Standard/Premium/VIP) and create leads in the services_leads table; form validates inputs and falls back to localStorage on failure.
user_flows: Navigate to /services.html -> Services page loads with plan options -> Select a service plan (Premium) -> Fill customer name field -> Fill phone number field -> Fill comment/details field (optional) -> Click order button -> POST to /rest/v1/services_leads -> See success confirmation "Order received"

Navigate to /services.html -> Services page loads -> Select a service plan -> Leave phone number empty -> Click order button -> See validation error "Phone required" -> Fill phone number -> Click order button -> See success confirmation

Navigate to /services.html -> Services page loads -> Select a service plan and fill form -> Click order button -> API call fails (server/network) -> See error message "Order failed, try again" -> See option to save draft locally -> Form data saved to localStorage
